chief_complaint: Uncontrolled hypertension with metabolic risk factors (obesity, prediabetes) and recent psychosocial stressors
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 41-year-old male with a history of essential hypertension diagnosed in 2021, currently stage 2 (BP 135/103). Since October 2024 he has documented obesity (BMI ≥30), increased stress, and recent intimate partner abuse, which may be contributing to poor blood pressure control and lifestyle factors. He has longstanding prediabetes (A1c 6.3%) and chronic anemia of unknown etiology. Chronic sinusitis has been present for decades with a recent acute bacterial episode resolved in October 2024. Pulmonic valve regurgitation has been noted since 1990 but lacks recent imaging. He is employed full‑time and has a high‑school education. Medication regimen is limited to lisinopril 10 mg, indicating possible therapeutic inertia despite multiple cardiovascular risk factors.
